CLAIMS.claim: Built a flash-sale commerce platform on .NET 10 with 234 automated tests passing (172 unit + 62 integration, 0 failures).
CLAIMS.note: Also state the gates. This is the project carrying Gates 1-7, which is a more interesting claim than the test count.

CLAIMS.claim: Designed and shipped an 8-gate acceptance suite where each gate is proven by a negative control, not just a passing assertion.
CLAIMS.evidence: docs/gate8-ai-ml-eval.json plus the per-gate evidence files
CLAIMS.metric: 7/8 gates VERIFIED, 1 PARTIAL; every gate has a demonstrated failure mode
CLAIMS.note: Lead with this rather than any individual test count. The negative-control discipline is the transferable part.

CLAIMS.claim: Demonstrated that a quality gate keyed on accuracy alone would have shipped a regression: a decision-threshold change raised accuracy 0.8373 to 0.872 while business cost rose 0.3227 to 0.4853 and recall fell 0.70 to 0.33.
CLAIMS.note: The single most defensible bullet here. It is a reasoned result about metric design, not a stack list.

CLAIMS.claim: Separated retrieval evaluation from generation so a broken retriever cannot hide behind a fluent answer, and proved the gate rejects the exact regression a refactor causes: removing the BM25 leg drops recall@3 from 0.4000 to 0.3059.
CLAIMS.metric: recall@3 0.4000 to 0.3059, MRR 0.3000 to 0.2078, gate rejects
CLAIMS.note: Always pair with the measured oracle ceiling of 0.80, because 17 of 85 answerable questions have no supporting text in the corpus. Quoting 0.40 alone invites 'that seems low', and the honest answer is more interesting than the number.

CLAIMS.claim: Deployed three services to Azure Container Apps on a consumption plan and verified the endpoints answer.
CLAIMS.metric: 3/3 Container Apps HTTP 200, 1 replica each, no ACR or AKS
CLAIMS.note: Say 'verified reachable' rather than 'production deployment'. These are scale-to-zero consumption apps for a portfolio, and inflating that is the easiest thing for an interviewer to unpick.

CLAIMS.claim: Fixed a vision-inspection defect where a quality-rejected camera frame was reported as a defect-free board, and where the existing no-verdict path crashed instead of degrading gracefully.
CLAIMS.metric: rejected frame returned [] pre-fix, None post-fix; 13 regression tests (honest RED 4 failed / 9 passed); full suite 210 passed; audit A5b FAIL -> PASS
CLAIMS.note: Sanctioned wording: 'Implemented explicit no-verdict handling for low-quality inspection frames to prevent invalid camera input from being misclassified as defect-free output.' Also mention that fixing it exposed a second bug: the no-verdict branch fell through into len(None) and raised TypeError, so the graceful path was a crash.

CLAIMS.claim: Changed a data-contract gate from fail-open to fail-closed after proving a validator exception was silently converting unvalidated rows into approved KPI inputs.
CLAIMS.metric: invariant VALIDATION_INFRA_FAILURE != DATA_ACCEPTANCE; 19 regression tests (RED 7 failed / 12 passed); full suite 212 -> 231 passed; audit F3 FAIL -> PASS, now 4/4
CLAIMS.note: Sanctioned wording: 'Added fail-closed data validation and quarantine handling to prevent malformed numeric records from entering production KPI calculations.' The stronger framing is that the fail-open was a DELIBERATE, documented decision that turned out to be wrong at the wrong layer -- and that a negative control preserves its valid intent, so one bad row still quarantines rather than aborting the whole file.

CLAIMS.claim: Demonstrated that a single similarity threshold cannot express answerability, by measuring four candidate evidence-sufficiency signals and declining to ship any of them.
CLAIMS.metric: 4 signals measured on 9 no-answer / 85 answerable rows. Best reached 0.000 on all 9 no-answer rows but accepted only 55.0% of answerable rows, so it was not shipped
CLAIMS.note: A NEGATIVE result, claimable precisely because it is measured and it changed a decision. Framing: distinguished relevance from answerability, proved the conflation with a measured score overlap, prototyped four replacements, and rejected the best one because it would have refused 45% of valid questions. NOT claimable: any statement that the system abstains correctly. Honest status is 1/9.
